poe.notes: JL256A; 2930F QuickSpecs 'PoE power 370 W PoE+' (internal fixed PSU, 459 W max rating).
JL258A; 2930F QuickSpecs 'PoE power 125 W PoE+' from internal fixed PSU.
JL074A; QuickSpecs 'PoE Power (Max Possible) 1440W' = chassis cap with both PSU slots filled (2x JL087A 1050W); PSUs are ordered separately (min 1), so no included-PSU base figure exists.
JL679A (12G Class4 PoE 2G/2SFP+ 139W); fixed 165 W PSU, 'Up to 139W of Class 4 PoE Power'.
JL677A (24G Class4 PoE 4SFP+ 370W); fixed 500 W PSU, 'Up to 370W of Class 4 PoE Power'.
JL675A (48G Class4 PoE 4SFP+ 370W); fixed 500 W PSU, 'Up to 370W of Class 4 PoE Power'.
JL725A (CX 6200F 24G Class 4 PoE 4SFP+ 370W); fixed PSU, 'Fixed power supply - Up to 370W of Class 4 PoE power'.
JL727A (CX 6200F 48G Class 4 PoE 4SFP+ 370W); fixed PSU, 'Up to 370W of Class 4 PoE power'.
JL661A; current QuickSpecs 'Max PoE power: 1600W' (supports JL086A/JL087A/JL670A 1600W PSUs, min 1 ordered separately); older CX 6300 datasheet quoted 1440W for 2x JL087A.
R8N87A; CX 6000 QuickSpecs 'Up to 370W of Class 4 PoE' on the fixed internal PSU (24p Class4 PoE 4p SFP 1G 370W SKU).
R8N85A; CX 6000 QuickSpecs 'Up to 370W of Class 4 PoE' on the fixed internal PSU (48p Class4 PoE 4p SFP 1G 370W SKU); the 740W variant is a different SKU (R9Y03A).
